To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a conserved pro residue in Dothi Avr4 proteins is required to elicit a Cf-4 dependent HR.
a conserved pro residue in Dothidomycete Avirulence proteins is required to induce a Cf-4 dependent hypersensitive response.
a single region in CfAvr4 is required for Cf-4 recognition and that this region is conserved in DsAvr and CaAvr/CbAvr.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the Dothideomyceset fungus Cladosporium fuvlum (teleomorph: Passalora fulva) evades the immune system of its host plant, the tomato (Solanum lycopersicum).
the molecular mechanisms of pathogenicity and resistance in the tomato-Cladosporium fulwum pathosystem, which is a model system for studying fungal pathogenicity and plant immunity.
the identification of the regions and specific amino acid residues in CfAvr4 that are required to trigger a hypersensitive response in plants transgenic for Cf-4, the Cf-4 receptor of tomato.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proline residue at position 58 of the Cf- and DsAvrs triggers the HR, while the arginine residue at the same position in the Ca- and CbAvrs is responsible for the lack of an HR.
the conserved proline at position 60 is essential for triggering a Cf-4 dependent HR.
a conserved amino acid residue is necessary and sufficient for the triggering of Cf-4-dependent resistance by Avr4 orthologue proteins.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the conserved proline in the Avr4 orthologue is required to trigger Cf-4 dependent HR, which is a prerequisite for the pathogenicity of the fungus.

we have identified the region in CfAvr4 required for Cf-4-dependent recognition, and we have determined that a single proline residue is necessary and sufficient to trigger the Cf-4-dependent response.
a single conserved amino acid residue is sufficient to confer a Cf-4 dependent HR.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a conserved pro residue in Avr4 orthologue proteins is required to elicit a Cf-4 dependent HR.
